# FloatTech - Digital Agency

## About
FloatTech is a premier digital agency delivering world-class digital experiences. We specialize in web design, development, and digital marketing services.

## Services
- UI/UX Design: Immersive digital journeys crafted with attention to every micro-interaction
- Website Design: Bespoke web designs that capture your brand essence
- Frontend Development: React, Next.js, and Tailwind based architectures
- Landing Pages: High-impact landing pages for marketing campaigns
- Business Websites: Scaleable digital platforms for enterprises
- Website Redesign: Modernizing legacy web applications
